author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Sonnet is lazy, it always asks me to look things up for it.
Opus will just go look things up itself without bothering me.

I suspect Anthropic deliberately train them this way.  Smaller weight sizes just mean it know less random knowledge; it should not make the model lazier.  

For many tasks, I just need the model keep digging, I don't need the model to know a lot of random knowledge.
